propositions: A new deterministic AST gate must flag every prohibited config/credential read (6 categories) in non-approved seam modules, reusing gen_env_registry's matchers for ambient env/helper-shim detection and adding rules for load_config calls, getattr(os.environ,...), provider-credential reads, and backend registry access.

The gate must resolve callee and receiver aliases (import forms, local bindings, conditional assignments to os.environ) so that direct, import-aliased, and local-aliased call patterns all correctly classify as ambient or credential reads.

Owner sets must be derived at runtime from existing registries (owned_secret_names(), decorator scan for @register, gen_env_registry.scan()) rather than hand-copied; a newly declared env name or credential without an owner must fail (drift self-test).

An initial legacy-exception set must enumerate current below-seam reads (exact path+symbol+rationale entries only; no globs) so the gate is introducible without product-code changes, drainable to empty by C3 cleanup.
Shim-shaped callees absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS and dynamic env reads must fail CLOSED as unresolved-env-read, detecting the b00f evasion and invisible helpers.

The gate must expose check(root)->list[str] and main(argv)->int contracts, include synthetic fixtures for all 6 categories and approved paths, run offline with no network/CI, and exit 0 on the current tree.
